scenes.audio: What would happen if you were stranded in the Alaskan wilderness for five days?
scenes.visual: Skeleton protagonist with visible eyeballs, red plaid flannel, cargo pants, backpack, stands on float of red/white seaplane on calm lake; pine forest, snowy mountains; concerned expression; soft morning light; two ducks take off.

scenes.audio: Day one. The float plane touches down on a remote lake and drops you off.
scenes.visual: Same skeleton on rocky lakeshore waving as seaplane takes off behind; holds blue sleeping mat; mountains reflected in water.

scenes.audio: You watch the plane disappear over the mountains.
scenes.visual: Back view of skeleton on high ridge over valley at sunset, orange/pink sky, hand at forehead watching plane leave; warm dramatic light.

scenes.audio: Now you're completely alone with just a knife and clothes on your back.
scenes.visual: Skeleton walks through dense pine forest, sunbeams through canopy; backpack, water bottle; knife sheathed on hip.

scenes.audio: Day two. You wake up freezing...
scenes.visual: Close-up of bony hands drawing fixed-blade knife from sheath; mossy forest floor background.

scenes.audio: ...and spend the entire day building a proper bushcraft shelter with logs and moss insulation.
scenes.visual: Skeleton carries log on shoulder, building lean-to of vertical poles; determined wide eyes.

scenes.audio: Your body is already weaker from eating nothing but berries...
scenes.visual: Skeleton crouches by lake looking at small pile of berries on rock; exhausted, slumped; lake and snowy mountains behind.

scenes.audio: ...and one small fish. A grizzly bear walks past your camp at dawn.
scenes.visual: Grizzly bear walks across foreground near shore; skeleton in background outside moss shelter, frozen in fear.

scenes.audio: You hold your breath and don't move.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of skeleton face peering between shelter logs, hands gripping logs, eyes wide with terror; dim shadowy light.

scenes.audio: Day three. You spend six hours trying to start a fire with sticks...
scenes.visual: On-screen 'Day 3'. Skeleton kneels using bow drill rapidly; smoke rises.

scenes.audio: ...and finally get a spark.
scenes.visual: Close-up of skull face blowing on tinder bundle catching fire; orange glow on skull.

scenes.audio: The warmth feels like heaven, but your stomach is eating itself.
scenes.visual: Skeleton sits by campfire at twilight, purple/blue sky, hands to flames, relieved; shelter and lake behind.

scenes.audio: You set fishing lines in the lake and catch two trout.
scenes.visual: Skeleton in shallow lake water pulling up line with two trout; excited.

scenes.audio: It's the best meal of your life.
scenes.visual: Night. Skeleton kneels by fire preparing fish on flat stone with knife; firelight flickers on ribs and skull.

scenes.audio: Day four. You hear wolves howling at night and don't sleep at all.
scenes.visual: On-screen 'Day 4'. Skeleton huddled in shelter at night; glowing yellow wolf eyes in dark forest; aurora borealis in sky.

scenes.audio: Your hands are covered in cuts from building fish traps and gathering firewood.
scenes.visual: Close-up of hands weaving branch basket; hands stained dark red with cracks; near water.

scenes.audio: Your mind starts playing tricks on you. You see things that aren't there.
scenes.visual: Semi-transparent ghostly female figure, long black hair, white dress, appears behind skeleton in night forest; skeleton startled, turns, reaches toward hallucination.

scenes.audio: Day five. You hear the floatplane engine in the distance...
scenes.visual: On-screen 'Day 5'. Skeleton in front of shelter cupping hand to ear; clothes now tattered and torn.

scenes.audio: ...and run to the lakeshore.
scenes.visual: Skeleton runs frantically through sunny forest toward lake.

scenes.audio: The pilot helps you inside and you fly home.
scenes.visual: Seaplane docked at shore; human pilot (bearded, cap) reaches out of cabin to help skeleton onto float.

scenes.audio: Your wife and three kids are waiting on the dock.
scenes.visual: Wooden dock by large log cabin; four skeletons (woman + three children) wave as seaplane approaches; mountains, sunset.

scenes.audio: You think about starting a YouTube channel to share what you learned.
scenes.visual: Inside warm log cabin, skeleton types on laptop at wooden desk; family on sofa reading behind; thoughtful, content.
